items.t: Arbor Realty Trust Consensus Price Target Decreased by 30.77% to $2.30
Arbor Realty Trust (ABR) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower After Analyst Target Cuts
items.sum: The fair value estimate for Arbor Realty Trust has been cut from US$3.25 to US$2.25, pointing to a much lower assumed equity value than before. That shift lines up with recent analyst commentary that has moved into the US$2 to US$2.50 range, reflecting concerns about higher mortgage rates, wider agency MBS spreads, and slower resolution of problem assets.
